name: Unity: Pause Menu
goalName: Pause the entire game except a specific object (pause menu)
goal: In most games, there is a pause menu, which (in singleplayer) freezes the whole game, except that menu. Since Unity does not have such function built in, I have to do it myself.

approach.text:

normalLearnings: I can halt certain events when a pause menu is being shown
result: As seen in the image below, the pause menu is shown like a layer in front of the game. The gray layer on the game indicates the game is frozen.<<image 3.png>>
validation: I showed my result to various users and peers.
contribution: The game is now one step closer to being finished now that the player can pause it.
